requirement.original: markdown一些特殊格式无渲染（包括一级标题二级标题等）
requirement.clarified: Several markdown primitives are not rendered in MarkdownView: strikethrough (~~text~~), task lists (- [x]/- [ ]), nested unordered lists with depth indentation, blockquotes (> text) including nested blockquotes, <kbd> HTML elements, and HTML entities (</>/&). Inline bold/italic/code/links must NOT regress. Headings H1-H6 ARE parsed correctly — the user's observation about headings may refer to numbered list items in the reference screenshots. This is spec §5.17.
requirement.what: Add 6 missing markdown rendering primitives to the custom parser-renderer pipeline: strikethrough spans, task list blocks, nested list depth, blockquote blocks, HTML entity decoding, and <kbd> rendering
requirement.why: User-facing markdown content containing these CommonMark/GFM constructs displays as raw source text, which is unreadable and confusing

excluded: footnotes, definition lists, other extended Markdown dialects

success_criteria: ~~text~~ renders with visible strikethrough, no raw ~~ visible
- [x] item renders with checked checkbox icon; - [ ] item renders with unchecked checkbox icon
- nested item renders with leftPadding indentation relative to parent
> quote text renders with left border, indented, no raw > prefix visible
>> nested quote renders with additional left indent/border
< renders as <, > as >, & as & in all text contexts
<kbd>X</kbd> renders as keycap-styled span or clean decoded literal
Bold/italic/code/links/headings/ordered lists/tables/code-blocks/LaTeX/Mermaid render identically before and after this change
constraints: Must not break existing block types: header, list, numbered-list, code-block, mermaid, latex, horizontal-rule, options, table, image
Must not break existing inline styles: italic, bold, semibold, code, link
Coordinate with §5.16 on parseMarkdownSpans.ts regex group indices
Use theme.colors.* and Typography.* — no hardcoded color/font values
React Native + Expo web compatible (no DOM-only APIs in render path)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Strikethrough, task lists, nested lists, blockquotes, <kbd>, and HTML entities render as raw source text in all MarkdownView surfaces
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The custom markdown pipeline (parseMarkdown.ts + parseMarkdownBlock.ts + parseMarkdownSpans.ts + MarkdownView.tsx) has never implemented these six primitive categories. The MarkdownSpan.styles union does not contain 'strikethrough'. The MarkdownBlock union has no 'blockquote' or 'task-list' type. The block parser has no branch detecting '> ' (blockquote) or '- [x]' (task). The span parser regex does not include '~~'. No HTML entity decode is applied anywhere in the pipeline.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 — fix: fix monorepo (initial creation of parseMarkdownBlock.ts — the primitives were absent from day one)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The initial implementation covered only the primitives needed at that time (headers, lists, code blocks, horizontal rules, tables, options). GFM extras (strikethrough, task lists, blockquotes) and HTML normalization were never in scope for the original author.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Claude's output frequently uses GFM constructs including > blockquotes for context, - [x] task lists for checklists, ~~strikethrough~~ for corrections, and </> entities for code discussion. These render as unreadable noise.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Never implemented — not a regression. Present since initial commit 7f178466 (Jan 2026).
